Entry Social Hierarchy of the Riverlands Entry Social Hierarchy of the Riverlands Nobles are connected to each other by kinship, bridges and manors, but farmers always re-sow seeds after the army passes by; the same set of order may appear natural in the hall, but appear extraordinarily solemn in the fields, docks or beside the campfire. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.

If a rule is practiced over and over again, it will find its way into rituals, crafts, and prayers; if it is sustained only by fear, cracks will show at the onset of a crisis.
